defaultUnit.title: Default measurement unit
defaultUnit.description: Default unit for measured items (e.g. m for meter, kg for kilogram, sqft for square foot, yd for yard, tola, carat, hr).

defaultDecimals.title: Default decimal places
defaultDecimals.description: Number of decimal places shown to shoppers (e.g. 2 for 1.25 m, 3 for 0.125 kg).

defaultStep.title: Default quantity step
defaultStep.description: The incremental amount by which shoppers increase or decrease quantity (e.g. 0.1 m or 0.25 m).

defaultMinQuantity.title: Minimum purchase quantity
defaultMinQuantity.description: The minimum measured quantity a shopper can add to cart.

defaultMaxQuantity.title: Maximum purchase quantity
defaultMaxQuantity.description: The maximum measured quantity a shopper can add to cart.

showUnitPriceInCatalog.title: Show unit price in catalog
showUnitPriceInCatalog.description: Display price per standard unit (e.g. $12.00 / meter) on product cards and listings.

enableFractionalStock.title: Track fractional inventory
enableFractionalStock.description: Count stock in thousandths of the measured unit for exact fractional inventory tracking.
